protocol.py: 4 biology problems (1 error, 2 warnings, 1 note).

1. ERROR PIPETTE-RANGE: 10 ul is below what the p300_single_gen2 can measure (20 ul at
least)
   line 72:  p300.aspirate(10, src_well)
   At line 72 the p300_single_gen2 is asked to draw 10 ul, below its minimum of 20 ul (this
   line did it 24 times). A pipette cannot measure less than its minimum: it draws the wrong
   amount, or nothing, and the volumes in this protocol only add up on paper. The simulator
   passes the move. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2 and 16 more in slot 7.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2 and 16 more in slot 7.
   Fix: Use a pipette whose range covers the volume (a p20 for 1 to 20 ul), or scale the
   reaction so every volume is at least the pipette's minimum.
   Source: Opentrons: pipette characteristics (volume ranges)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/pipettes/characteristics.html
   Source: Integra: pipetting tips (work at 35 to 100% of nominal volume)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/united-states/en/pipetting-tips
   [13e29a90d2b1]

2. WARNING MIX-TOO-WEAK: Mixing too weak to stir 20 wells: 2 × 50 ul in 60 ul
   line 48:  p300.mix(2, mix_vol, dest)
   reached through: run:64 > transfer_with_tip:48
   At line 48 the tip mixes wells A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B2, B3, B4 and 12 more in slot 7 with
   2 strokes of 50 ul in a well holding 60 ul (this line did it 20 times). 2 strokes of 50
   ul move 1.67 of the well in all; it takes about 2 wells' worth of strokes to mix (the
   mixing work). Fewer than 3 strokes do not mix a well. Integra draws over 80% of the well
   five times; three mixes gave 11.8% CV where twenty gave 1.7%. What the well holds is not
   at the concentration you calculated, and in a dilution series every later step inherits
   the error.
   Affected: wells A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B2, B3, B4 and 12 more in slot 7.
   Fix: Mix the well with about 80% of its volume (48 ul) at least 5 times: `mix(5, 48,
   well)`. A stroke of the whole well draws air; use no more than 90%.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   Source: Integra: three serial-dilution protocols (over 80% of the volume, five times)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applications/3-simple-and-proven-automation-protocols-serial-dilutions-assist-plus-pipetting-robot
   Source: Beckman AMPure XP instructions (mix with a tip volume just below the well volume)
           https://research.fredhutch.org/content/dam/research/hahn/methods/Agencourt%20AMPure%20XP.pdf
   Source: Esca Automation: serial dilution, a classic technique
           https://escaautomation.substack.com/p/serial-dilution-a-classic-technique
   Source: labautomation.io 3654: how to mix a bacteria sample enough
           https://labautomation.io/t/how-to-mix-bacteria-sample-enough/3654
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   [1b3fab6c5ddd]

3. WARNING MIX-TOO-WEAK: Mixing too weak to stir 24 wells: 2 × 50 ul in 100 ul
   line 74:  p300.mix(2, 50, dest_well)  # mix in assay plate
   At line 74 the tip mixes wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2 and 16 more in slot 8 with
   2 strokes of 50 ul in a well holding 100 ul (this line did it 24 times). 2 strokes of 50
   ul move 1 of the well in all; it takes about 2 wells' worth of strokes to mix (the mixing

   the concentration you calculated, and in a dilution series every later step inherits the

   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2 and 16 more in slot 8.
   Fix: Mix the well with about 80% of its volume (80 ul) at least 5 times: `mix(5, 80,

4. NOTE NO-NEGATIVE-CONTROL: No blank on a dilution series: 6 wells of compound 1
   line 46:  p300.dispense(vol, dest)
   reached through: run:56 > transfer_with_tip:46
   At line 46 the robot starts a dilution series of compound 1 in NEST 96 Well Plate 200 µL
   Flat (slot 7): 6 wells at 6 concentrations, each level about 3 times weaker than the one
   before. No well on this plate holds dmso with no sample, so there is no blank: the curve
   has no zero to read against, and a signal from the diluent or the plastic cannot be told
   from the lowest point. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5 and A6 in slot 7.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5 and A6 in slot 7.
   Fix: Add a well of dmso alone, and tell the plate map where it is.
   Source: MIQE 2009: a no-template control on every plate is essential
           https://gene-quantification.com/miqe-bustin-et-al-clin-chem-2009.pdf
   Source: MIQE 2.0 (2025): the no-template and no-RT controls, still essential

   Source: Bustin 2025: MIQE compliance remains patchy

findings.title: No blank on a dilution series: 6 wells of compound 1
findings.explanation: At line 46 the robot starts a dilution series of compound 1 in NEST 96 Well Plate 200 µL Flat (slot 7): 6 wells at 6 concentrations, each level about 3 times weaker than the one before. No well on this plate holds dmso with no sample, so there is no blank: the curve has no zero to read against, and a signal from the diluent or the plastic cannot be told from the lowest point. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5 and A6 in slot 7.
findings.fix: Add a well of dmso alone, and tell the plate map where it is.
